note: Machine-readable index of the reference adapters shipped in this repository. The full installer catalog is larger; run `agentweb sites` and `agentweb capabilities DOMAIN` for the live inventory. Regenerate with: python scripts/build_capabilities_index.py

operations.description: Download the rendered PDF for a known public arXiv paper and return a local file receipt with an integrity digest.
Download the public source bundle for a known arXiv paper and return a local file receipt with an integrity digest.
Retrieve arXiv's BibTeX citation text for a known public paper identifier.
Read and normalize the current public RSS announcements for an exact arXiv category.
Retrieve normalized metadata for one or more exact arXiv identifiers, including version-specific records when requested.
Find public arXiv papers credited to a named author and return the newest matching records with normalized metadata.
List official arXiv bulk-access resources for metadata, PDFs, source archives, terms, and incremental harvesting.
List arXiv's complete public archive and subject-category catalog with canonical browsing links.
List the newest public papers in an exact arXiv subject category with normalized metadata and stable offset pagination.
List the public format, source, help, and scholarly-resource links exposed by arXiv for a known paper.
List official public arXiv information, help, policy, status, statistics, accessibility, and project-resource links.
Read the normalized text of an official public arXiv information, help, policy, accessibility, statistics, or project page.
Search the complete public arXiv corpus with its expressive query language and return normalized paper metadata.

sites.name: npm
sites.description: Complete browserless interface for npm's anonymous public registry and website surfaces: discovery, metadata, releases, dependencies, dependents, downloads, provenance, security, package contents, documentation, and service health.

operations.description: Check explicit public npm package versions against npm's bulk security advisory service.
Download one public npm package tarball and return a private local file receipt with its SHA-256 digest.
Return npm's aggregate download count for a package over a named period or explicit date range.
Return a bounded daily npm download series for up to 366 days with local cursor pagination.
Return a bounded package overview with the latest release, tags, maintainers, links, and README preview.
Return bounded npm publish and SLSA provenance attestations with transparency-log identifiers.
Read the package README directly from the registry with an explicit character bound and truncation signal.
Return npm's current overall status, component states, and active public incidents.
Resolve an exact version or distribution tag and return its normalized manifest, dependencies, and integrity data.
List one package version's runtime, development, peer, optional, and bundled dependencies in normalized pages.
List packages that npm currently shows as depending on a public package, using npm's browser-compatible public page.
List public packages associated with an npm maintainer account using the registry's maintained search index.
Inspect a published npm tarball and list its files, sizes, modes, and entry types without extracting it.
List a package's releases in publication order with dates, deprecations, manifests, and distribution integrity.
Read one bounded regular file directly from a public npm tarball as UTF-8 text or base64.
Read a bounded public npmjs.com policy, product, help, or docs.npmjs.com page without opening a browser.
Search the public npm registry with npm's text, keyword, maintainer, and scope query syntax.

sites.name: wikipedia
sites.description: Broad public Wikipedia research across search, pages, links, categories, history, languages, geography, users, and random discovery.

operations.description: Verify the retained Wikipedia session and report the authenticated user, groups, rights, and block state.
Bounded read-only escape hatch for MediaWiki query, parse, opensearch, and help actions. Write actions are rejected.
Call a fixed-host MediaWiki Action API operation. Read actions use GET; mutations use POST, require confirm, reuse the retained login session, and fetch a fresh CSRF token automatically.
List main-namespace pages that link to an article.
List the visible categories assigned to an article.
List pages and subcategories inside a Wikipedia category.
Create or replace a Wikipedia page through the MediaWiki Action API. AgentWeb fetches the CSRF token automatically; confirm is mandatory.
List image and media file pages used by an article.
List available language editions for an article.
List main-namespace pages linked from an article.
Find geotagged Wikipedia pages near coordinates.
Read a Wikipedia page as bounded plain text with canonical metadata.
Return daily public pageviews and a total for a date range.
Return random article titles and links from a Wikipedia language edition.
List recent page revisions with editors, comments, sizes, and timestamps.
Search Wikipedia article titles and text with compact snippets.
List an article's section hierarchy and anchors.
Upload a local file through MediaWiki's multipart Action API. AgentWeb fetches the CSRF token automatically and never returns the local path; confirm is mandatory.
List a public Wikipedia user's recent contributions.
